At this price point, even conservative rents deliver excellent cash-on-cash returns with minimal capex needed upfront.Perfect for:House hackers or BRRRR investors
Portfolio builders seeking low-maintenance rentals
Short-term rental conversion (proximity to the Falls)

Strong bones, recent improvements, and a location in a historically tight-knit neighborhood position 1634 Linwood as a solid, no-fluff addition to any cash-flow-focused real estate portfolio. Serious investors — this one won’t last long in today’s market. Reach out for comps, rental analysis, or to discuss acquisition!
